description: Nigeria - Kaduna Electricity Distribution Company Service Area Settlements Dataset is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Demographics, Transmission and distribution", published or maintained by Yann Tanvez (Columbia University Earth Institute). Data collected as input to the geospatial least-cost plan for universal electricity access by 2030 developed as part of the ESMAP funded World Bank Nigeria Electricity Access Project (NEAP). The dataset covers the service area for the Kaduna Electricity Distribution Company (KEDCO) Nigeria. Coverage: Nigeria. It has 8 files in GeoJSON, CSV. The portal files it under Demographics, Transmission and distribution. The portal gives 2016 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
